name: spot-eth/eth-trend-filter
title: ETH trend filter (SMA40 + inverse-vol)
description: Long/flat spot ETH gated by a 40-day SMA trend filter and sized by inverse EWM realised vol (halflife 20, target 0.5 annualised, hard-capped at 1.0). One decision per day at the 23:59 UTC close print.
live_notes: Cost assumption in the report matches the venue's taker fee (10 bp/side); no known gap.

backtest_series.parquet's weight column is pre-shifted: row t holds the weight decided at the close of t-1. The runner's --check weight for today corresponds to tomorrow's row in that file, not the last row.
Recommended kill switch from the spec (not part of the alpha): if trailing 90-day realised Sharpe drops below -0.5, halve exposure until it recovers above 0.
Signal is computed from real Binance spot ETHUSDT daily klines; the yfinance ETH-USD daily close the research used differs by <2 bp of weight (both are faithful to the spec).
